# catalystcenter_application_set (Resource)

Manages a custom Catalyst Center Application Set. The controller ships roughly 29 built-in application sets (`collaboration-apps`, `consumer-gaming`, ...) which are seeded and must not be managed by this resource. The API exposes no update verb, so every attribute forces replacement. `terraform import` expects the two-part identifier `<name>,<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_application_set" "example" {
  name                       = "my-app-set"
  default_business_relevance = "BUSINESS_RELEVANT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_business_relevance` (String) The business relevance this application set defaults to. It determines which column the set is pre-populated into in the Application Policy GUI; an application policy may still override it per policy.
  - Choices: `BUSINESS_RELEVANT`, `BUSINESS_IRRELEVANT`, `DEFAULT`
- `name` (String) The name of the application set

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import catalystcenter_application_set.example "<name>,<id>"
```
